title: ICSE CLASS 4 — English | Pronouns
description: Subject-wise test on Pronouns (English) for ICSE CLASS 4. 40Q.
subject: icse4-english

questions.question: My name is Rina. _____ love to play with my friends.

options.explanation: Incorrect because 'He' refers to a male person other than the speaker.
Incorrect because 'She' refers to a female person other than the speaker.
'I' is the correct personal pronoun to refer to oneself as the subject of the sentence.
Incorrect because 'We' refers to a group of people including the speaker.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a personal pronoun used as an object?

questions.question: The children were very hungry, so Mother gave _____ some snacks.

questions.question: This storybook is not yours. I think it is _____ because it has his name written inside.
